ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 65-70% high-intensity white background vs 30-35% low-intensity black patterning.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dense distribution of small-to-medium circular black spots (rosettes) across the entire visible white substrate; high-intensity solid black region at the central peduncle attachment point radiating outwards into the lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; approximately 40-45 degree angle; depth is roughly 12% of the visible vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrated boundary along the trailing edge; pixel amplitudes of 'teeth' vary from 5 to 20 pixels; highest serration density located on the medial-to-distal sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral upward sweep; trailing edges exhibit a slight concave curvature towards the tips; leading edges (partially submerged) show convex curvature.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extreme density of localized, roughly circular black clusters (rosettes) distributed across the entirety of both lobes, suggesting significant historical barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct linear disruptions; notable set of 3-4 parallel diagonal rake marks on the left lobe (viewer perspective) and intersecting linear scars on the right lobe near the central notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy biological fouling/barnacle clusters visible on the terminal tips of both lobes (yellowish-brown textured masses); reddish-brown staining/pigmentation localized on the ventral surface near the lower leading edges.
other_distinctive_markers: The extreme density and uniformity of the 'spotted' pigmentation pattern across the white surface is highly distinct, coupled with significant barnacle load on the fluke tips.
